_comment: Free-only setup. Copy exact model IDs from each provider's model page (console.groq.com/docs/models, openrouter.ai/models, ollama.com) and check they are still free before running. Groq free tier: per-model limits, roughly 30 req/min, 1,000 req/day, 8,000 tokens/min, 200,000 tokens/day - the TOKEN limits are what bind here, so calls are spaced ~20 s apart and capped at 75 per run (prompts measured at ~1.1-1.2k tokens).

models._note: OpenAI open-weight 120B; too big for a laptop, free on Groq
copy the current Qwen model ID from console.groq.com/docs/models
small model on your laptop, shows the effect of model size

judge._note: judge from a family NOT tested above (e.g. Llama on Groq); copy exact ID from console.groq.com/docs/models
